Anna (customer): Hi, getting parse errors client-side when using JSON mode + streaming. The stream ends mid-object, missing trailing brace. Happens ~1/20 requests, customer on Cloudflare worker proxy.

Emily N.: Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the last ~2KB of the stream or a curl output? Any repro code?

Anna (customer): I ran: curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -N "https://api.redwood.com/v1/streams?mode=json" > out.raw then parsed out.raw and got "Unexpected end of JSON input". Attached a trimmed tail: 

```
{"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{\"name\":\"summary\",\"items\":[\"line1\",\"line2\"],\"meta\":{\"len\":2}},\"finish_reason\":null}}`
```

(there's no closing ] or } - stream cut)

Samir K.: Thanks Anna. Do you see any 502/504 or connection resets in the headers? Also, which SDK / client?

Anna (customer): Using node fetch in worker. No visible 502, socket closed. Request headers show keepalive: timeout but proxied through CF.

Ada (Support): Looping in eng-runtime and infra. @Samir K. can you repro via a CF worker proxy? Might be Cloudflare buffer/timeout chopping last chunk.

Samir K.: Repro attempt: ran same curl via an intermediate nginx reverse proxy, I see identical truncated tail when I trigger a short network hiccup (simulated with `tc qdisc netem loss 1% delay 30ms`). Suspect mid-chunk FIN from upstream or client token refresh closing connection.

Mike R.: Two hypotheses: (1) proxy (CF/nginx) times out and closes connection while a chunk is mid-flight -> partial JSON; (2) auth refresh flow on client triggers reconnect without consuming final chunk. Both produce early EOF.

Emily N.: Customer mentioned billing/auth refresh earlier in their support ticket — they renew token after ~30s. Could be taking place during long responses.

Samir K.: Quick workaround: stream can be wrapped with a guarded final object. Suggest appending a small sentinel chunk at the end like `{"__end":true}\n` from server-side once full payload assembled. For immediate customer workaround: 1) enable SSE event framing OR 2) use newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) and parse line-by-line so partial-object errors are localized.

Ada (Support): Proposed to customer: ask their CF worker to pass through via `fetch` with `duplex: 'half'` and disable buffering (CF may still buffer large responses but some settings help). Also request full HAR or tcpdump of failed session.

Anna (customer): Ok I'll try NDJSON and share HAR. Do you need a repro token or can you reproduce internal?

Samir K.: If you can share a short repro token (scoped to support) + sample prompt that reproduces the long streaming response, we'll attempt internal repro through a CF worker. If they can't share token, a minimal synthetic repro that streams ~12KB and then we simulate a mid-chunk FIN will be enough.

Mike R.: Logging notes for eng: add finer-grained streaming metrics: last-byte-sent timestamp per connection, reason for graceful close vs reset, and a chunk-boundary size histogram. For now, we should search for client-side TLS FIN around the timestamps Anna supplied and any intermediate proxy logs showing `upstream prematurely closed connection` or `write: broken pipe`.

Emily N.: Filed support ticket SP-3821 and set priority P2 (customer in paid plan). Ada, tagging infra and runtime on the ticket — also requesting a short-circuit patch for sentinel chunk configurable at model-serving layer.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: no active deploys affecting runtime in last 24h.

Samir K.: Next actions: (1) Anna tries NDJSON + HAR (2) we attempt internal repro behind CF worker + netem (3) infra to review edge proxy timeouts/keepalive settings and search logs for `RST`/`FIN` at 1755554321..1755554399 window.

Anna (customer): Thanks, will send HAR + try NDJSON. Appreciate quick responses :thumbsup:

Emily N.: Thanks Anna — please post HAR link here when ready and we'll pick up.
